[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 05:19  
[EVENT] User is looking for new recipe ideas for a brunch gathering with cousins.  
[RELATIONSHIP] User has cousins with whom they have regular brunch meetings.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers casual, shareable dishes suitable for a buffet-style setting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested popular brunch recipe ideas including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Sweet Treats**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stuffed French Toast: Cinnamon-infused bread filled with cream cheese, strawberries, and blueberries, topped with maple syrup and powdered sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cinnamon Roll Waffles: A twist on traditional waffles, topped with cream cheese frosting, caramel drizzle, and chopped nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Banana Bread Pancakes: Fluffy pancakes loaded with mashed bananas, walnuts, and a hint of cinnamon, served with a side of whipped cream and caramel sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Egg-stravagant Options**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Eggs Benedict: Toasted English muffins topped with poached eggs, Canadian bacon, and hollandaise sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs: Crispy bread topped with mashed avocado, poached eggs, cherry tomatoes, and a sprinkle of red pepper flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Quiche Lorraine: A French classic filled with eggs, heavy cream, and lardons (small pieces of bacon) baked in a flaky pastry crust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Savory Delights**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Breakfast Burrito Bar: Tortillas filled with scrambled eggs, chorizo sausage, black beans, and shredded cheese, served with salsa, sour cream, and avocado.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Grilled Chicken and Waffles: Crispy fried chicken served atop a fluffy waffle with maple syrup and butter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Spinach and Feta Omelette: A fluffy omelette filled with wilted spinach, crumbled feta cheese, and a sprinkle of sun-dried tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Beverages**:
